text: 4,13 Post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorders (PTLD) oc- cur in lung transplant recipients, often in association with a primary Epstein-Barr virus infection.3,4,12 The incidence is high in paediatric patients, ranging from 13 to 20%. Ini- tial treatment involves a reduction in immunosuppression, or chemotherapy with rituximab.3,12 The induction of immune tolerance remains the ultimate goal in lung transplantation.1,11 Combined heart-lung transplants have also been per- formed, see under Heart Transplantation, above. 1.
